csv_project_name: CMAR for Mcintosh Power Plant Unit 5 Admin Building Addition
csv_scope_of_work: Construction Manager at Risk Services (CMAR) for the McIntosh Power Plant Unit 5 Administration Building Addition. The project will be at McIntosh Power plant, adjacent to the existing Unit 5 Administration Building, located at 3400 East Lake Parker Drive, Lakeland, Florida. The proposed two-story addition will be constructed on the south side of the existing Unit 5 Administration Building and will provide approximately 11,100 square feet of new office, conference, and support space across two floors. The first floor will serve existing staff with 19 private offices, a large conference room, collaboration space, chemistry laboratory, kitchen, mechanical / electrical room, and restrooms. The second floor will accommodate future growth with additional offices, conference room, break room, backup control room, mechanical / electrical room, and restrooms. The floors will be connected by an interior stairwell, and the second floor will connect to the existing building via an elevated breezeway which will require some modification to the existing building as required to make this connection.
